postRequest.what: Put something on the pinboard: a request, an offer or something to lend.

listOpenRequests.what: Show what is open on the pinboard.

listMyRequests.what: Show your own open posts on the pinboard.

respondToItem.what: Respond to a post on the pinboard.

cancelRequest.what: Withdraw a post from the pinboard.

assignLend.what: Lend something to someone; the post stays open.

markReturned.what: Say that something you lent is back.

getItemTree.what: Show a post with everything attached to it.

listFeed.what: Show what is new in your circle.

getPinboardProfile.what: Show what others see of you on the pinboard.

startDm.what: Start a conversation with one person.

setHolidayMode.what: Switch holiday mode on or off.

getHolidayMode.what: Show whether holiday mode is on.

setContactTrust.what: Choose how much you trust a contact.

setContactHidden.what: Hide a contact, or show it again.

listMessageRequests.what: Show first messages from people you did not choose.

holdMessageRequest.what: Keep a first message from someone you did not choose as a request.

params.file: whether a file came with it
params.refused: why it did not get through

acceptMessageRequest.what: Accept a request: whoever sent it becomes a contact.

params.revealPreset: how much they see of you

ignoreMessageRequest.what: Ignore a request; you can still accept it later.

mintSharedCard.what: Make a link someone can add you as a contact with.

listSharedCards.what: Show the contact links you shared, and whether they were used.

withdrawSharedCard.what: Withdraw a contact link; whoever opens it later lands in requests.

clearContactLinkToken.what: Forget which link a contact came in through.

useSharedCard.what: Remember that someone used a contact link of yours.

setContactPersona.what: Choose as which persona a contact sees you, and how much.

params.revealPreset: how much they see of you

setContactPersonKey.what: Record a contact's key, from their card.

params.links: the proof that it is theirs

getContactShareQr.what: Show the code someone can add you as a contact with.

conflictDisputeWizard.what: Raise an objection in your circle.

postAudienceWizard.what: Put something on the pinboard for part of the circle.

createGroupWizard.what: Make a new circle, in five steps.

joinGroupWizard.what: Join a circle: read the rules and choose your name.

getCurrentGroup.what: Show which circle you are in now.

listGroupMembers.what: Show the members of your circle.

params.spineless: also who is not confirmed yet

memberStatus.what: Show how things stand with a member of the circle.

setMyLocation.what: Say roughly where you are; the circle does not see it exactly.

geocode.what: Look up a place name; nothing is kept.

getDataLocation.what: Show where your data rests: on your pod or on this device.

setMyHandle.what: Choose your handle in this circle.

listMyHandles.what: Show your handles, one per circle.

subscribeWebPush.what: Let this device get notifications in the browser.

getVapidPublicKey.what: Fetch the key the browser needs for notifications.

getCircleStoragePolicy.what: Show where a circle's data rests.

setCircleStoragePolicy.what: Choose where a circle's data rests; it holds for everyone.

podSignInStatus.what: Show whether you are signed in to your pod.

dismissRemovedCircle.what: Close a circle you were removed from; this device forgets it.

listCirclePostsSince.what: Show a circle's posts since a moment.

getLatestPostAddedAt.what: Show when the latest post in a circle came.

listConsentingPeers.what: Show the members who agreed that you may contact them.

getMetrics.what: Show this device's counters; they go nowhere.

createGroupV2.what: Make a circle you run, with rules and invites.

params.name: the name
params.inviteExpiresInHours: for how many hours an invite holds

redeemMembershipCode.what: Join a circle with a code.

recordRemoteRedemption.what: Record that an admin confirmed your joining.

acknowledgeCaretaker.what: Confirm you have seen this circle is now yours to run.

setMemberRole.what: Make a member an admin of the circle, or undo that.

params.policyVersion: for which version of the rules

removeMember.what: Remove a member from the circle; the key changes.

params.policyVersion: for which version of the rules

getCurrentMembershipCode.what: Show the code to invite someone.

rotateMyGroupCode.what: Make a new invite code; the old one stops working.

params.inviteExpiresInHours: for how many hours an invite holds

params.policyVersion: for which version of the rules

recordGroupRulesUpdate.what: Record new circle rules another member sent.

recordRosterSeed.what: Take over the member list from your other device.

getGroupRulesUpdateStatement.what: Show the signed change of the rules.

postAnnouncement.what: As admin, post an announcement to the circle.

whoAmI.what: Show who you are on this device.

addContactFromQr.what: Add a contact with a scanned code.

params.revealPreset: how much they see of you

acceptResponder.what: Choose someone who responded to your post.

broadcastCircleGovernance.what: Send a proposal or vote to the circle.

broadcastCircleChatStatement.what: Send a signed chat message to the circle.

broadcastCircleItems.what: Send a change to an item to the circle.

broadcastCircleRecipe.what: Send a shared template to the members.
